name: How do custom home finishes change ground-up construction pricing?

mainEntity.name: Why do finish selections have such a big effect on the final price of a new home?
mainEntity.text: Why do finish selections have such a big effect on the final price of a new home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish level can change the total budget more than many homeowners expect. A home with standard materials and common fixtures will cost far less than one with custom cabinetry, specialty stone, large-format tile, premium windows, high-end appliances, and detailed millwork. The labor to install certain finishes can also rise when the materials are more complex or require more precision. In custom home construction, finish decisions affect not just appearance but also lead times, coordination, and change-order risk. The best way to control the budget is to make finish selections early and keep a clear allowance list so the project team knows what quality level is expected. If the project is intended as a luxury build, the finishes should be priced as a core part of the design, not as an afterthought.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish selections affect pricing because cabinetry, tile, stone, flooring, windows, fixtures, and appliances can vary dramatically in cost and installation complexity. Even when the structure is similar, upscale finishes can move the total budget far higher. In a custom home, finish level is often one of the biggest drivers of the final number.
